_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Extended journal version of O_ISAC_043. Photonic-based W-band ISAC (FiWi). Flexible TFDM waveforms (10 cases) for adaptive resolution/rate. 10km Fiber + 1m Wireless.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Flexible TFDM waveform grid (10 Cases). Fig 3: Experimental setup (CO -> 10km Fiber -> BS -> 1m Wireless -> UE). Fig 10-13: Comprehensive performance analysis (BER, SNR, Resolution, ROP impact).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonic-aided W-band ISAC (FiWi). Sensing: LFM Radar. Comm: SCM QAM. Method: Flexible resource allocation (TFDM) with 10 defined cases balancing time/frequency.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 15-60 Gbps (SCM 32-QAM). Sensing: 1.59-4.39 cm resolution. Fiber: 10 km. Wireless: 1 m. Distance error < 3cm after calibration.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Highly flexible system addressing diverse 6G use cases. Detailed analysis of system delay and phase noise. Shows clear trade-off between Comm Rate and Radar Resolution.

bibliographic.title: Photonic-Based W-Band Integrated Sensing and Communication System With Flexible Time-Frequency Division Multiplexed Waveforms for Fiber-Wireless Network
bibliographic.authors: Boyu Dong, Junlian Jia, Li Tao, Guoqiang Li, Zhongya Li, Changle Huang, Jianyang Shi, Haipeng Wang, Zhenzhou Tang, Junwen Zhang, Shilong Pan, Nan Chi

application.scenario_description: Fiber-wireless integrated network serving diverse V2X scenarios (Raw Data, SLAM, Platooning) using adaptive waveforms.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Comprehensive W-band Photonic ISAC system with 10 flexible TFDM waveform cases for adaptive optimization of Rate vs. Resolution.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Inflexibility of fixed TDM/FDM in meeting diverse V2X sensing/comm requirements.

transmitter.notes: Photonic generation of 96.5 GHz W-band signal. 12 GHz total bandwidth. 1550nm lasers.

receiver.notes: 100 GHz PD for O/E. Envelope Detector for Wireless Rx.

integration.notes: Flexible TFDM with 10 defined cases (FDM, TDM, Hybrid).

channel_fibre.notes: 10 km SMF used for transport loop.

comm_metrics.notes: Data rates 15-60 Gbps (Peak/Avg vary by Case). BER < 1E-2.

sensing_metrics.notes: Resolution 1.59-4.39 cm. R_max depends on waveform parameters (1.45m - 15.1m theoretical). Accuracy < 3cm.

tradeoff.notes: 10 Cases explicitly mapping the Rate vs Resolution trade-off space.
